items.title: Millions lose access to benefits and pensions services after 'cyber incident'
items.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions says some of its services were taken offline as a precaution.

items.title: Catherine's emotional cancer documentary strips away the stiff upper lip
items.summary: The Princess of Wales has made a documentary, Heal, describing her cancer experience in her own words.

items.title: Pharmacies get new powers to swap prescriptions during shortages
items.summary: If a medicine is out of stock, staff can offer the same drug in a different strength or form, like a capsule instead of a pill.

items.title: Set time aside for children to read for pleasure, schools to be told
items.summary: The government says its new cirriculum hopes to reverse declining literacy rates and combat "mindless scrolling".

items.title: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
items.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez wants to defy the polls, and his main rivals accuse him of not telling the truth and of "betrayal".

items.title: 'Calculating predator' who blackmailed girls into self-harm jailed for 14 and a half years
items.summary: Beau-Jack Mensforth is jailed for preying on nine girls, the youngest aged 12, across the world.

items.title: Charity founded in Captain Tom's name bids to be struck off
items.summary: The charity is now known as the 1189808 Foundation, having dropped the late fundraiser's name.

items.title: Weary of war but with no sign of backing down, Kyiv faces another punishing winter
items.summary: Ukraine settles in for another devastating winter as the questions persists: how will it all end?

items.title: New satellite data shows how fast some African cities are sinking
items.summary: Cities including Lagos and Alexandria are sinking faster than previously thought, a new study shows.

items.title: 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law apologises in court to the families of his victims
items.summary: The Canadian man, who pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding and abetting suicide earlier this year, said he was remorseful for his actions.

items.title: Pharmacies offering children flu jab for first time after surge in hospital admissions
items.summary: More than 6,000 pharmacies across England are offering thousands of children flu vaccines for the first time if they missed their jab at school.

items.title: Son of Hamas chief and his family survive Israeli airstrike, group says
items.summary: The son of the Hamas chief and his family survived an airstrike by the Israeli military, according to a senior official for the terrorist group.

items.title: Kate in tears over her children's voice messages in cancer documentary
items.summary: The Princess of Wales can be seen brushing away tears as she listens to voice messages from her children during her Three Peaks Challenge in a new documentary about her cancer battle.

items.title: Police seek 100 concertgoers over mass evacuation at Manchester rap gig
items.summary: A "small group of organised criminals" are being sought by police after an unknown substance sparked a mass evacuation at a Manchester concert.

items.title: Body found in woodland confirmed as missing Kelsey Hunter
items.summary: The body of a woman found in woodland in Scotland has been identified as 20-year-old Kelsey Hunter, who went missing over the weekend.
